"Never let your knees go past your toes." One of the most common gym rules we hear, and for most healthy lifters it's a myth. 🙅‍♂️

Your knees move forward whenever your ankles bend: squats, lunges, stairs, even your golf posture. A classic squat study (Fry et al., 2003) found that holding the knees back shifted much more of the load to the hips and low back.
✅ Keep your heels down
✅ Let the knee track in line with your toes
❌ Don't force a depth you can't control

Knee pain that sticks around? Get it checked instead of avoiding the movement.

Save this for your next leg day.
